hooks.name: Review a new component against design.md
hooks.description: Reviews a new component against the design tokens and the honesty rules in design.md before it spreads.

action.prompt:
A new file was created in components/. Review it against .kiro/steering/design.md and UI_DESIGN.md and report concrete violations:

1. Tokens only: no literal hex colours, no radius outside 6/8/10 px, no font size outside the documented scale, spacing on the 4 px base.
2. Honesty: every figure has a unit; anything that is not a direct measurement carries a StatusTag; missing data reads "Not available" and never 0; a risk flag or unresolved constraint is never hidden behind a good score.
3. Language: "near transmission" is never "grid capacity available"; "vacant" is never "for sale"; a low band is never described as predicted opposition.
4. Accessibility: keyboard reachable, visible accent focus ring, aria-expanded on disclosures, aria-pressed on chips, real table semantics with scope, colour never the only signal.
5. Anti-template: no gradients, glow, emoji, repeated KPI cards, arbitrary animation, or dead buttons; reduced motion honoured.

List each violation with the line and the fix. If the file is clean, say so in one line.
